column1: # Campaign 25 ownership transfers, appended only as each dependency root is implemented and promoted.

column9: note

Transfer remains PARTIAL; the successor owns one signed-BIGINT equality and lazy required-row, cancellation, and error cleanup, while arbitrary residual other conditions, hash probe layout, collisions, SQLKiller, selection vectors, chunk capacity, both build orientations, typed key layouts, selected chunks, and 200-row batches remain open; the immutable split-domain label for TestInnerJoinProbeOtherCondition remains planner-executor-typed-join-runtime.

Transfer remains PARTIAL; the successor directly owns INNER/CROSS projection and required-row behavior, while prior RIGHT ON/USING/NATURAL TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN behavior and right scan order remain implemented in select.rs; Go Joiner cloning, inline projection beyond bounded direct offsets, generic required-row chunking, physical build/probe variants, allocator/spill behavior, build-side memory bounds, non-BIGINT types, and outer/semi joins remain open.

Transfer remains PARTIAL; the successor bounds output allocation by caller row demand, while exact InitChunkSize allocation, cloned other-condition chunk capacity, generic field types, allocator accounting, and build-side memory bounds remain open; the immutable split-domain label remains planner-executor-typed-join-runtime.

Transfer remains PARTIAL; the successor proves zero demand performs zero child pulls and one-row calls resume within one multi-match left row, while outer joins, generic field types, and exact Go Chunk.SetRequiredRows early-fill behavior across the type matrix remain open; the immutable split-domain label remains planner-executor-typed-join-runtime.

The bounded executable and fallible shutdown authority are retained while ordered multi-table configuration becomes the single startup contract; full TiDB startup modes and service wiring remain PARTIAL.
Existing failure-safe handshake draining remains the canonical connection lifecycle while the foundation prepares the multi-relation dispatch seam; full handshake compatibility remains PARTIAL.
The fixed-worker listener and ordered shutdown authority remain single while the reusable query lifecycle is exposed for the live join consumer; full server behavior remains PARTIAL.
The bounded connection accounting authority is retained under the ordered-table foundation; dynamic per-user admission and distributed accounting remain PARTIAL.

The shared tag-owned live harness remains canonical while default-preserving fixture, argument, and readiness hooks are added for the final two-table proof; broad RealTiKV lifecycle behavior remains PARTIAL.
